name: Draw.io Diagrams
description: Edit and embed draw.io diagrams (.drawio, .drawio.svg, .drawio.png) in markdown
author: Altus Nova

marketplace.tagline: Edit and embed draw.io diagrams in your notes
marketplace.longDescription: Create, edit, and embed [draw.io](https://www.diagrams.net/) diagrams without leaving Nimbalyst. Open `.drawio`, `.drawio.svg`, and `.drawio.png` files in a full draw.io canvas, drop or paste diagrams straight into markdown, or insert a new diagram with a slash command. Diagrams are saved as standard files with embedded draw.io metadata, so they stay compatible with GitHub, VS Code, and the Confluence draw.io pipeline.
highlights: Full draw.io canvas as a custom editor and an inline edit overlay
Insert diagrams with the /Draw.io Diagram slash command
Drag-drop and paste .drawio, .drawio.svg, and .drawio.png into markdown
Round-trips as standard SVG/PNG/XML with embedded draw.io metadata

screenshots.alt: Client to API to database architecture diagram open in the draw.io editor
